images.prompt: Photorealistic split-screen vertical fashion editorial image, divided exactly in half by a clean straight vertical seam at the center. The top 28 percent of the whole image is empty plain background on both halves, nothing there. LEFT HALF: a flat lay product photograph viewed from directly above on a light ivory plaster background, no person, items only in the lower 72 percent, neatly arranged top to bottom with small gaps: a long single-breasted warm brown suede coat with notch lapels laid flat, a soft heather grey cashmere V-neck cardigan with a crisp white button-down shirt collar peeking inside it, a slim brown leather belt coiled, a pair of ivory wide-wale corduroy straight trousers, a pair of brown suede chelsea boots, and a small pair of tortoiseshell sunglasses. RIGHT HALF: a full-body street style photo of a young Korean man in his 20s wearing exactly the same items: brown suede coat open over the grey V-neck cardigan and white shirt, brown leather belt, ivory corduroy straight trousers, brown suede chelsea boots, walking calmly on a quiet Seoul stone-paved street with blurred autumn trees, only in the lower 72 percent. Headless body-only framing: the body is cut at the collarbone by the frame, NO head, NO chin, NO mouth, NO hair, NO neck visible. Identical items in both halves, realistic fabric textures, soft overcast daylight, 35mm film look, no film border. No text, no letters, no logos, no brand marks, no signs.
